# Implementation Plan: Lean tracked-only body-stripped projection (`lean-tasks.json`) + read routing

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph --from-brainstorm` on 2026-06-24. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/overview-data-json-further-breakdown-for-readability/plan.md`.*

<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"overview-data-json-further-breakdown-for-readability"} -->

## Overview

`.ralph-overview/data.json` (the HOT shard, ~402 KB / 72 tracked tasks) is hard to read because ~76% of its bytes are BODY bulk — `command.prompts` (~45%) + `kanbanCards` html (~31%) — not the task spine. The shipped hot/cold two-shard split (ralph-overview 2.12.0) already separated `merged`/`archived` tasks into `data.archived.json`, but no *generated read view* is BOTH tracked-only AND fully body-stripped: `active-tasks.json` (357 KB) is tracked-only yet keeps full bodies; `summary-projection.json` (975 KB) strips command bodies but NOT `kanbanCards` and is all-tasks (larger than the hot shard).

This plan implements **D-001** (3-lens unanimous brainstorm verdict @ `bc44003c`): add a new **additive generated lean projection** `lean-tasks.json` (tracked-only + every heavy body class stripped to a small marker, keeping the task spine), reuse one shared strip helper to ALSO strip `kanbanCards` in `summary-projection.json`, add a per-scope navigation section to the generated `tasks/INDEX.md`, and route docs/agents to read the lean surfaces first. The canonical hot/cold STORE, the loader's assembled `{tasks:[...]}` shape + order, the watcher, the MCP server, the React viewer, and `data-edit` are all **UNCHANGED**. No `data/` subdirectory is created (it would collide with watcher invariant #14, the Windows cold-start hang).

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
- Seeded from brainstorm: `.ralph/brainstorms/overview-data-json-further-breakdown-for-readability/selected-direction.md` (D-001).
- **Projection emitter seam:** `ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph-overview/scripts/lib/emit-projections.mjs:20-40` (`emitProjections`) emits `active-tasks.json` (`:29-33`, filter `lifecycle==='tracked'`) and `summary-projection.json` (`:35-39`, `tasks.map(stripColdBodies)`). The strip helper `stripColdBodies` is at `:42-65`: shallow-clones task + command, replaces `descriptionHtml` and `prompts` with `{ stripped:true, approxBytes:N }` via `strippedMarker` (`:63-65`). It never mutates the input.
- **Sole call site:** `scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs:570-598` (`emitAgentArtifacts`); `emitProjections` is invoked at `:589-597`, AFTER `snapshot.json` is written at `:581-582`, so projections never affect snapshot bytes.
- **Config wiring (mirror exactly):** default paths at `scripts/lib/default-config.mjs:21-22` (`activeTasksJson`, `summaryProjectionJson`); resolution in `scripts/lib/resolve-config.mjs` at BOTH the destructure block (`:134-135`) and the resolved-outputs rebuild (`:175-176`). Type interface at `scripts/lib/default-config.d.mts:11-23` (NOTE: it currently OMITS both existing projection keys — a pre-existing gap to backfill). Plugin config schema lists both at `templates/overview-config.schema.json:35-36`.
- **Index generator:** `scripts/lib/emit-tasks-index.mjs` (`buildTasksIndex`) renders a flat list of `## <taskId>` blocks from `snapshot.tasks`. Snapshot tasks DO carry `scope` (verified: snapshot task keys = `id, scope, lifecycle, status, lastTouchedAt, kanbanCards, command, initialStage`), so per-scope grouping is feasible without touching the snapshot builder.
- **Task spine (verified):** top-level keys `id, scope, lifecycle, status, lastTouchedAt, kanbanCards, command` (+ `shipManifest` on merged tasks). `command` sub-keys `name, descriptionHtml, warnings, prompts{brainstorm?,plan?,impl?}`. `kanbanCards` = array of `{ className, html }`. `scope` is often pipe-delimited multi-scope (`"crews|codex"`).
- **Config deep-merge:** `resolve-config.mjs::mergeObject` (`:105-117`) DEEP-merges `outputs`, so a new default key survives even if the consumer config omits it; but the explicit destructure means an un-wired key would not be path-resolved. Wire it explicitly in resolve-config like the existing two.

### Technical Constraints
- **Watcher invariant #14 (HARD):** the data watcher runs at `depth:0` over `path.dirname(config.dataFile)` and only recognizes the hot + cold same-dir siblings (`watch-ralph-state.mjs:326-347,398-408,452-462`). The new projection MUST be a same-dir sibling under `.ralph-overview/generated/` (which it is — same dir as the existing projections, NOT a sibling of `data.json`). Do NOT add a `data/` subdirectory of the store.
- **Additivity / purity:** `snapshot.json`, the assembled `{tasks:[...]}`, `active-tasks.json`, and every other existing projection MUST stay byte-identical on the current corpus. Only `summary-projection.json` changes (by design — it gains the kanban strip), the new `lean-tasks.json` appears, and `tasks/INDEX.md` gains the nav section.
- **Generated-file git status (verified):** `.ralph-overview/generated/*.json` projections are UNTRACKED (on disk, not committed, not ignored) → `lean-tasks.json` will be untracked too; the impl does NOT commit it (the watcher regenerates it). `tasks/INDEX.md` IS tracked → the buildTasksIndex change yields a tracked diff the impl regenerates + commits once.
- **Consumer schema drift (tightly-coupled bug):** `.ralph/overview-config.schema.json` has `outputs.additionalProperties:false` (`:23`) but does NOT list `activeTasksJson`/`summaryProjectionJson` — although `.ralph-overview/config.json` already uses them. The schema is editor-only (not runtime-enforced), but the plan brings it in sync (adds all three) so it stops lying.
- **Plugin release invariant #6:** a version bump must update `plugin.json` + all three marketplace indexes + `CHANGELOG.md`, and the codexu `AGENTS.md` active-plugin-versions table (CI invariant-check source of truth).

## Approach

### Architecture
Reuse the existing additive-projection machinery rather than introducing any new mechanism. One shared, purity-preserving strip helper is extended to (a) add prompt **presence flags** and (b) strip `kanbanCards`; both `summary-projection.json` (all tasks) and the new `lean-tasks.json` (tracked-only) consume it, so the lean view is exactly the tracked subset of the (now-fully-stripped) summary — no duplicated strip logic. Config wiring, schema, types, and docs mirror the two existing projections one-for-one.

### Lean projection shape (decision)
Each lean task is a shallow clone with the spine kept verbatim and the three heavy body classes replaced by small markers:
- Kept verbatim: `id`, `scope`, `lifecycle`, `status`, `lastTouchedAt`, `command.name`, `command.warnings`, and any `shipManifest` (tracked tasks normally have none).
- `command.descriptionHtml` → `{ stripped:true, approxBytes:N }`.
- `command.prompts` → `{ stripped:true, present:{ brainstorm:bool, plan:bool, impl:bool }, approxBytes:N }` (prompt PRESENCE flags). **`present[k]` is defined as a non-empty trimmed string** (`typeof prompts[k] === 'string' && prompts[k].trim().length > 0`), NOT mere property existence; all three keys are always emitted.
- `kanbanCards` → array of `{ className, approxBytes }`, ORDER PRESERVED (card CLASSES + counts via array length; html dropped).

**Command-independence (Phase-4 finding F-006):** `kanbanCards` live at the TASK level, not under `command`. The current `stripColdBodies` early-returns the unmodified task when `command` is missing — which would leak raw kanban `html` for a command-less task that has cards. The extended helper MUST strip `kanbanCards` at the task level INDEPENDENTLY of whether `command` is present, and only strip command bodies when `command` is an object.

`summary-projection.json` uses the identical extended helper (so it also gains presence flags + kanban strip); `lean-tasks.json` = `tasks.filter(t => t.lifecycle === 'tracked').map(stripColdBodies)`, preserving the assembled hot-then-cold order exactly like `active-tasks.json`.

### Implementation Strategy
1. Extend `stripColdBodies` in `emit-projections.mjs` once (presence flags + a new `stripKanbanCards` sub-helper); keep it pure (shallow-clone task + command + map cards). `summary-projection.json` now reflects the kanban strip.
2. Add the `lean-tasks.json` emit branch (tracked-only filter + the extended map) + config wiring: `default-config.mjs`, `resolve-config.mjs` (both blocks), `default-config.d.mts` (add the new key + backfill the two existing), `templates/overview-config.schema.json`.
3. Extend `buildTasksIndex` with an additive "Tasks by scope" navigation section (split multi-scope on `|`, dedup, sort scopes alpha, list task-id anchor links in snapshot order) ABOVE the unchanged `## <taskId>` detail blocks.
4. Route reads: codexu `AGENTS.md` (lean projection is the canonical lean read; add to "Other generated files"), consumer `.ralph-overview/config.json` (+ `.ralph/overview-config.schema.json` drift fix), and the plugin AGENTS.md "Lazy read projections" note.
5. Release bookkeeping: bump `plugin.json` 2.12.0 → 2.13.0, the 3 marketplace indexes, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the codexu AGENTS.md active-plugin-versions table.

## Scope
### In Scope
- New additive `lean-tasks.json` generated projection (tracked-only + fully body-stripped spine) wired through `config.outputs.leanTasksJson` in `default-config.mjs` + `resolve-config.mjs` + `.d.mts` + plugin schema.
- Extending the shared strip helper so `summary-projection.json` ALSO strips `kanbanCards` and both projections expose prompt presence flags.
- Additive per-scope navigation in the generated `tasks/INDEX.md`.
- Read-routing docs (codexu `AGENTS.md` + plugin docs) + consumer config/schema sync.
- Unit + integration tests; plugin version bump + marketplace/CHANGELOG/active-plugin-versions table.

### Out of Scope
- ANY change to the canonical hot/cold STORAGE layout, the loader/assembly (`sync-core.mjs:859`, `data-store.mjs`), the write core (`data-edit-core.mjs`), `migrate-split.mjs`, the watcher, the MCP server, or the React viewer. The assembled `{tasks:[...]}` shape + order stays byte-identical.
- Per-scope / per-task SUBDIRECTORY shards (D-003) — rejected (watcher invariant #14).
- Body-sidecar extraction that shrinks the canonical EDIT file (D-002) — a deferred follow-up, pursued only if D-001 read-routing proves insufficient.
- Changing `active-tasks.json` (it stays tracked-only-with-full-bodies for body-needing consumers).

## Risk Areas
- **`tasks/INDEX.md` is tracked + live-regenerated:** the buildTasksIndex change produces a working-tree diff on every watcher pass. Impl must regenerate + commit INDEX.md once; reviewers should expect the large reformat diff. Existing test asserts `## <taskId>` headings survive — the nav section must be additive, not a replacement.
- **Test churn:** changing the shared `stripColdBodies` shape (adds `present`, strips kanban) breaks the existing exact-deepEqual summary assertions in `emit-projections.test.mjs` — those MUST be updated in the same story (expected, not a regression).
- **Consumer schema `additionalProperties:false`:** adding `leanTasksJson` to `.ralph-overview/config.json` without updating `.ralph/overview-config.schema.json` would make the (editor-only) schema reject it. Update both together.
- **Lean size expectation:** keeping `command.warnings` verbatim could leave the lean view larger than a pure-spine view. It still drops the dominant prompt+kanban bulk (~76%). If further shrink is needed, stripping `warnings` is a cheap follow-up lever (note in Open Questions) — but do not strip it now without confirmation, since dependency notes aid triage.
- **Determinism:** the lean filter/map must run over the assembled `overviewData.tasks` (hot-then-cold) exactly like `active-tasks.json`, and serialize with `JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2) + '\n'`, so re-runs produce no churn.
- **`generatedAt` byte-instability (F-002):** `emitProjections` stamps `generatedAt` with `new Date().toISOString()` when no timestamp is passed, and `emitAgentArtifacts` does NOT pass one, so the projection *files* differ run-to-run on the timestamp line. Byte-identical assertions MUST target the `.tasks` array (the existing `sync-core.test.mjs` baseline already compares `.tasks`), not whole files.
- **INDEX.md anchor correctness (F-011):** task IDs contain `/`, `.`, `_`, `-`; markdown auto-slug anchors are renderer-dependent and would break `[id](#id)` nav links. Emit an EXPLICIT anchor (e.g. an `<a id="task-<raw-id>"></a>` element or a documented, tested slug) in/above each detail block and point nav links at it; cover multi-scope + punctuation IDs in the test.
- **Test not wired (F-007):** `scripts/lib/emit-tasks-index.test.mjs` exists but is absent from the `test:lib` explicit file list in `package.json`, so it is NOT run by `npm test` today. The new nav assertion must be accompanied by adding that file to the list (or placed in an already-listed test).

## Acceptance Criteria
- A sync emits `.ralph-overview/generated/lean-tasks.json` containing ONLY `lifecycle === 'tracked'` tasks, each with `command.prompts`, `command.descriptionHtml`, and `kanbanCards` replaced by markers (prompts marker carries `present:{brainstorm,plan,impl}` defined as non-empty-trimmed-string; kanban marker is `[{className,approxBytes},...]`), spine fields (`id, scope, lifecycle, status, lastTouchedAt`) kept verbatim.
- `lean-tasks.json` is materially smaller than `active-tasks.json` AND less than 40% of the `data.json` hot-shard size on the current corpus (concrete, verifiable threshold — replaces "small fraction").
- A command-less task that has `kanbanCards` still gets its cards stripped (no raw kanban `html` in `lean-tasks.json` or `summary-projection.json`).
- `summary-projection.json` now also strips `kanbanCards` (a unit test asserts no raw kanban `html` remains and the marker is present) while remaining all-tasks.
- `snapshot.json` and the assembled `{tasks:[...]}` from `loadOverviewData` are byte-identical to a pre-change baseline on the current corpus; `active-tasks.json`'s `.tasks` array is byte-identical to baseline (the per-run `generatedAt` stamp means tests compare `.tasks`, not the whole file — F-002).
- `tasks/INDEX.md` exposes an additive per-scope navigation section using an EXPLICIT, tested anchor scheme that works for task IDs containing `/`, `.`, `_`, `-` and for multi-scope (`a|b`) tasks; the existing `## <taskId>` detail blocks (and the `## TASK` test assertion) still pass; the nav test runs under `npm test` (its file is added to the `test:lib` list).
- `config.outputs.leanTasksJson` is wired in `default-config.mjs`, `resolve-config.mjs` (both blocks), `default-config.d.mts`, the duplicate `scripts.d.ts`, `templates/overview-config.schema.json`, and `templates/overview-config.template.json`; the consumer `.ralph/overview-config.schema.json` lists all three projection keys.
- codexu `AGENTS.md` + plugin docs (`README.md`, `docs/configuration.md`, plugin `AGENTS.md`) route readers to `lean-tasks.json` first; `data-edit` remains the only documented mutation path.
- `npm test` (plugin-local: `scripts/lib` + projections + the newly-listed index test) passes on Windows. `plugin.json` (all three engine manifests) → 2.13.0 with the 3 marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG + active-plugin-versions table updated in lockstep; `node tools/validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs` passes.

## Open Questions
- **Projection filename:** plan uses `lean-tasks.json` (config key `leanTasksJson`). The brainstorm selected-direction floated `active-summary-tasks.json`. `lean-tasks.json` is shorter and distinct from `active-tasks.json`; the lead may override at impl.
- **Keep `command.warnings` in the lean view?** Kept verbatim now (dependency notes aid triage). If the lean view must be even smaller, stripping `warnings` to a marker is a cheap follow-up — confirm before doing so.
- **Per-scope INDEX placement of multi-scope tasks:** plan lists a task under EACH constituent scope (split on `|`). Acceptable duplication for a generated nav aid; alternative is grouping by the raw scope string (no duplication, more groups).
